Answer from memory: which word belongs to this topic?
Which word belongs to this topic?
Core Active Vocabulary (9 items):

house — a building where a family lives. Example: My friend's house is near.
apartment — a home in a larger building. Example: She rents an apartment in the city.
flat — a home on one floor of a building. Example: My flat is on the third floor.
room — a part of a building with walls. Example: My room is small.
building — a structure with walls and a roof. Example: The building is very old.
big — large in size. Example: It is a big house.
small — little in size. Example: They live in a small flat.
old — having existed for a long time. Example: The building is old.
new — recently made. Example: They live in a new apartment.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I live in a ...
• Do you live in a house or a flat?
• It is a big old building.
• My flat is on the third floor.
• It is new.
Vocabulary practice: choose the correct word.
Which word means 'a building where a family lives'?
Which word means 'a home in a larger building'?
Complete the sentence with a word from the list.
Stress the noun after the preposition.
I live in a FLAT.
Listen and repeat three times.
Which word carries the main stress?
Grammar focus: Verb "live".
Use live + in for homes: I live in a house. I live in a flat. Put the adjective before the noun: a big old house.
Controlled practice: choose the correct option.
Choose the correct preposition.
Choose the correct order.
Complete the sentence.
Reading: read the text and answer the questions.
I live in a small flat in an old building. My friend lives in a big house with a garden. My grandmother lives in a new apartment near the sea.
Listening: listen to the dialogue and answer the questions.
A: Do you live in a house or a flat? B: In a flat, on the third floor. A: Is it old? B: Yes, the building is very old.
